messages:
yara: Heads-up: publish for @redwood/python-sdk on release/0.9.x is blocked. regen-check flagged diffs and our auth/retry integration tests are failing in CI. Suspect typegen change touched auth enums and broke header building.

dev: failing test snippet: ```
def test_retry_on_401(monkeypatch):
    calls = []
    def fake_request(*a, **k):
        calls.append(1)
        return Response(status=401) if len(calls)==1 else Response(status=200)
    monkeypatch.setattr(http_client, 'request', fake_request)
    resp = client.do_something()
    assert len(calls) == 2  # expected a retry on 401
```
CI output: retry count was 1 but got 1? actually got 1 but no auth header on retry because enum mismatch made builder return empty header.

kevin: enum rename? which change in typegen?

yara: typegen 2.1.0 renamed AuthScheme values from BEARER/KEY to AUTH_BEARER/AUTH_KEY. Codegen templates generate an enum-to-header map; our runtime switch didn't accept AUTH_* variants so header was omitted on retry. That's a functional regression.

devex-bot: regen-check workflow failed on release/0.9.x (job: regen-compare). Summary: 7 files changed. CI: https://ci.internal/1799991234/regen

dev: short-term fixes: 1) patch codegen to keep backward-compatible enum labels for patch releases, 2) make runtime auth header builder accept both old and new variants, 3) add unit test that simulates retry with 401->200 across languages. Which do we prioritize?

kevin: do 1 + 2. We should avoid exposing breaking semantic changes in patch channels. Also file an RFC to formalize enum/name changes as semver-major for typegen.

yara: opened PR #2567 to canonicalize enum labels in codegen for release branch and PR #2568 to runtime to accept both naming forms. Both include regen updates for python and node. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2567, https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2568

ci-bot: retriggered pipeline for release/0.9.x (build #1799991299).

dev: local run: `make regen LANGS=python,node` -> examples updated and tests for retry auth pass locally. Pushed commits.

kevin: follow-ups: (A) add cross-language auth/retry smoke in regen CI, (B) add a release checklist item: "verify auth/shapes parity for SDKs on regen diffs", (C) RFC for typegen semver policy around enum/name changes.

yara: created issues for A/B/C and added a short how-to in devex handbook on running auth/retry smoke locally.

ci-bot: build #1799991334 succeeded, regen-compare clean. publish job resumed.

release-bot: publish job for @redwood/python-sdk 0.9.3 succeeded. docs site rebuild passed.

yara: closing thread. Thanks for quick turnaround everyone. :tada:

devex-bot: thread closed by yara (action: publish-complete)
